code_blocks.instructor_explanation: In our Vite config, we have to set up the Tailwind CSS plugin. So at the top over here, I'm going to import Tailwind CSS from at tailwind/vite, and in the list of plugins, I'm going to add Tailwind CSS over here.
And what I do want to do is I want at the top import Tailwind CSS, just like this. And what this will do is it will now apply the different Tailwind classes that we want to use into our project.

I'm going to put it right at the top so top zero, and the width of it is going to be full. I'm setting a transition all, and that transition is going to have the duration of 300. Now, I'm going to add this class name called Backdrop Blur, which allows us to put a little blur into the.
